test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"operates."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is written in the present tense, so we need a verb that agrees with the subject **"entire world."**
 
• The subject** "entire world" **is singular, so we need a singular verb with it.
 
• **"Operates"** is the present tense form of the verb **"operate"** and it is singular also.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.​
 
• Correct passage:

When trust is broken, as it is being done often in the present-day world, the world seems upside down for the people who are suffering due to their trust being broken. When close friends or close relatives break their trust__, it is __quite__ natural to feel hurt and experience misery. But, __holding__ a grudge or waiting to take revenge damages both, mental and physical health. This is a very crucial stage for anybody. One needs to understand that he is already suffering and that negative emotions like revenge, grudge, and anger will let him/her down completely. What should one do when __one's__ trust is broken is the question. Mind coaches, religious gurus and wellness trainers suggest a noble quality of ‘Forgiveness’. It is the quality which we need to practice for our own well-being. It does not simply mean forgetting what happened. It is understanding from others’ point of view. If there is something comprehensible, we can try to repair the relationship. Forgiveness helps to be good and makes one stand high in every human relationship. So, forgiveness is not only powerful but also power-giving. The entire world, along with the lives of the people in it, __operates__ on trust. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2,** "operate,"** is the base form of the verb and is used for plural subjects or in imperative sentences.
 
• Option 3, **"operated,"** is the past tense form of the verb and would be used to describe an action that happened in the past.
 
• Option 4, **"have operated,"** is the present perfect tense form of the verb and would be used to describe an action that started in the past and continues up to the present. 

e:
